Description:
This beautifully decorated and bright two-bedroom property offers a fantastic combination of traditional charm and modern living. The spacious living room is flooded with natural light and features attractive period detailing, including a charming fireplace, while still providing a comfortable and stylish space to relax and entertain.

The modern kitchen is well presented and thoughtfully designed, with intregrated appliances including a dishwasher and handy boiler water tap. The kitchen offers excellent storage and plenty of workspace. 

Both bedrooms are generous doubles, providing comfortable and versatile accommodation, whether used as bedrooms, a home office or guest space.

The property further benefits from a modern bathroom, an additional WC and fantastic storage throughout, creating a practical and well-organised home. Finished to a high standard and offered fully furnished, this property is in fantastic condition and ready to move into.

Please note, this property is only available until October 2027.

Location:
Bruntsfield Place is situated in one of Edinburgh's most desirable and vibrant residential areas. The property is ideally positioned to enjoy the fantastic selection of independent shops, cafés, restaurants and bars available in nearby Bruntsfield and Morningside.

The beautiful open spaces of the Meadows are within easy reach, while Edinburgh city centre is also easily accessible on foot or via the excellent public transport links available nearby. This is a fantastic location for enjoying the very best of city living while benefiting from a well-established and highly sought-after neighbourhood.
